lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Long may it stay empty!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not so loud. Sir Robert has ears.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Who's the stranger? Buy them a drink!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's {player}. They buy the drinks round here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sing for {dead}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They hated singing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then we'll sing badly. For them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Draw to the ear, not the chin.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: My ear's not where you think it is.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Lord says every man shoots on a holy day.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the Crows had better come on a holy day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Wind's rising. Aim off a hand.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Aim off a hand and I hit the miller.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Worth it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: {band} are close. Shoot like you mean it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I mean it. My arrows don't.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Home after this?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Home after this. Bolt the door.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Priest asked us to pray for the guild parties.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Riftgate lost another five, they say.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Pray for the beacons.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Pray the wardens stay sober.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Short sermon.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Even the priest's hungry.

who: two people wandering through town

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where are we going?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nowhere. That's the pleasure of it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Lot of new faces at the gate.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Refugees. Don't stare, it shames them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Smell that? Bread.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not for us. That's the keep's oven.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Shall we look at the hero lodge?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And watch them polish? Fine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oasis is low this year.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The last spring's all that keeps it wet. Mind the warlock's toll.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How far to the shrine?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Two days if the road's kind.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: When is it ever kind?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Mother Alice will hear me. She hears everyone.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Twenty years in that cell. She'll have heard worse.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: {band} took a band of pilgrims last spring.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then walk faster and pray louder.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My feet are bleeding.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. That's what we came for.

lines.text: I came for forgiveness, not blisters.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Flagellants up ahead.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Stay clear. Brother William's been recruiting from them.

lines.text: I'll confess it to Mother Alice and no other.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: If I could tell you, I'd not need to walk.

lines.text: Camp here. Too dark to see the road.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Bread's run out.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The hospice gives a dole. Two hours, no more.

lines.text: Slavers took folk from {hamlet}.

lines.text: Then we pray for them at the shrine first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Any news?

lines.text: Then tell me the best of it.

lines.text: The pedlar swears {hamlet} was raided by {band}.

lines.text: Leak at {hamlet}, I'm told. Horrors at the folds.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then I'm not taking my cart that way.

lines.text: {hamlet} is empty. Doors open, hearths cold.

lines.text: Slavers? Horrors?

lines.text: Nobody stayed to say.

lines.text: A hero broke {band}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Which hero?

lines.text: Slavers left a mark on the gate at {hamlet}.

lines.speaker: B

lines.text: The guild lost {dead} at the rift.

lines.speaker: B

lines.text: Who's that asking questions?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Watch your purse.

lines.text: Bet you a penny {band} hit us before Sunday.

lines.speaker: B

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Ones. Snake eyes.

lines.text: Bad luck. Like {dead}.

lines.text: The Lances throw for pay they never got.

lines.text: Then they're throwing air.

lines.speaker: A

lines.text: Wait where?

lines.text: Feed the hamlets, my lord, or lose them.

lines.text: Feed them and lose the granary. Choose your poison.

lines.text: {band} grow past thirty. A hero must go.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And leave the keep thinner. The Moot is close.

lines.text: Sir Robert wants your voice at the Moot.

lines.text: {player} could be useful.

lines.text: Useful, or dangerous?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Watch the hands, not the faces.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hands are full of bread.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Today. Watch tomorrow.

lines.text: That crowd's turning ugly.

lines.text: They're talking about {hamlet}.

lines.speaker: B

lines.text: Give us bread.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And keep the Crows off it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Pray for the harvest.

lines.text: Pray for {hamlet}.

lines.text: Both. There's room.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: For the beacons, the walls and the wardens.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Amen. And for the steward's mercy at tithe time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Lord, keep the wells sweet.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And {calamity} far away.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you for full barns.

lines.text: Sister Matilda walks bread out to the herders after prayers.

lines.text: The hospice used to have cheese.

lines.text: Wounded guildsmen again. Three from Riftgate.

lines.text: Refugees from {hamlet}. Twelve of them.

lines.speaker: B

lines.text: The ransom fund's short again.

lines.speaker: B

lines.text: Then pay it a third time. Next.

lines.text: {band} burned {hamlet}, my lord. We beg for a hero.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I've heard. I'll consider it.

lines.text: Grain, my lord. Only enough for the winter.

lines.text: Every hamlet wants grain. Which deserves it?

lines.text: The wolves take our folds every night, my lord.

lines.speaker: B

lines.text: Sir Thomas, the Crows took my son.

lines.speaker: B

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Deliver us.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: From what?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: From whatever comes next.

lines.text: Lord, deliver us from the Blight.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Deliver us from the lords who let it in.

lines.text: {calamity} is walking. I can feel it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Pray, then. Pray loud.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Deliver us from hunger.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And from the steward's tally.

lines.text: Let the slavers pass us by.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Lord, let them pass. Let them pass.

lines.text: Someone left a coin.

lines.text: Someone left a debt. They always come back for those.

lines.text: The stone on the hill had offerings again.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not ours. Old ways. Let it be.

lines.text: Grey cracks near the shrine's step.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Pour the holy water. Now. Before dark.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: In that order?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: More pilgrims than ever.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Fear's a good preacher. Better than our priest.

lines.text: For a murder, she says. Not hers.

lines.text: No room in the hospice.

lines.speaker: B

lines.text: Horrors were seen near {hamlet}.

lines.text: Dawn's coming.

lines.text: Because he will.

lines.text: Tell him all of them. That should do it.

lines.text: Private? That's either an honour or a burial.

lines.text: Both!

lines.text: A bounty on {band}! Twenty coin a head!

lines.text: Twenty coin. They'll be killing each other for it.

lines.text: Let it be known: {player} is named friend of this hold!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Friend. That's coin from the keep, mark me.

lines.text: The Hearth-Moot is summoned!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: All five lords in one hall. Bring a long knife.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: By order: no grain leaves the town.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the hamlets starve instead of us. Lovely.

lines.text: I'll pray for the same, then.

lines.text: I pray for rain.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I pray for the steward to choke.

lines.text: Separately, then.

lines.text: For {dead}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: For {dead}. Rest easy.

lines.text: The clan saint watches the miners.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Pray he watches the deep tunnels. Not just the bright ones.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then I'll take your purse after.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Mind his left. Thomas Fox taught him.

lines.text: My grandfather knew it. I know the bruise.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Fight fair.

lines.text: Fair is for tourneys. This is honour. Different rules.

lines.text: {player} will second you?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: If they'll have me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then you might live.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Dance!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: With these feet?

lines.text: With any feet!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: {band}'s broken! Ring the bells!

lines.text: Ring them twice! I owe {band} a burned barn!

lines.text: {hamlet} is ours again!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ours to rebuild, too. Drink first, dig later.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Full granary!

lines.speaker: B

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They say the calamity's slain.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then raise a cup and keep one eye on the March.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've called him out. Dawn, by the well.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Over what?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Over a pig. And honour. But mostly the pig.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: He insulted my clan before the hall.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then answer it. Clan blood doesn't wait.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'll challenge {player}.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You'll lose.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Throw down the glove.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The stone's warm. In winter.

lines.text: The leylines are stirring.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The Lord is near.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Or something is. Not all warmth is holy.

lines.text: Is he cheating?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Always.

lines.speaker: A

lines.text: Thin breakfast for a hunt.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thin hunt to match. The deer are gone.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A lodge hunter didn't come back.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: {dead}. Wolves, or worse.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Raise a cup before we ride.

who: huntsmen rewarding the hounds at the curee

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Give the hounds their share. Liver and lights.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: On the hide, not the ground. Old custom.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Blow the mort.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: My lips are frozen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then blow cold.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The hounds eat better than we do.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The hounds caught it. We only shouted.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good hart. The lord took the right shoulder.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And the steward took the rest. Hounds got luckier.

who: common folk waiting to petition Margaret the Sage

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Margaret the Sage is here. In our town.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then I'll ask her about my boy. He sees lights in the river.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: She woke the gift in a cobbler, they say. Robert Cordwainer.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then she might wake mine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They say she sends the awakened to the tower school.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: My daughter's not going to Mereworth. Not alone.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will she ask the lord's leave first?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The Sage asks nobody's leave. That's why lords hate her.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Ask her about the Blight.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Everyone asks about the Blight. She just says 'the leylines'.

who: sorcerers meeting in conclave at a stone circle

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nine of us. Count again.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nine. The circle holds.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then speak quietly. Stones carry.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The leyline's humming tonight.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So's the Blight. They feed from the same well.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Margaret wants us to declare ourselves.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: To the lords? They'd hang us or hire us. Same leash.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: {calamity} drinks the leylines dry.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then we must drink faster. Or bind it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A cobbler in First Hearth woke.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Untrained? He'll burn his shop down. Find him.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Lord's men on the road below.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Break the circle. Walk home separately. As always.
